# Results

Independent boards reduce discretionary accruals by 1.8 percentage points (Table 3, column 2), and
the estimate survives firm fixed effects and the 2002 listing-rule shock. The effect is twice as
large in firms with dispersed ownership.

Whether the reduction reflects monitoring or selection is still open: independent directors may
choose firms whose accounting is already clean. Section 5 uses the exogenous board turnover from
director deaths to separate the two.
